title: Casper and the Extraction
author: Jude Coldharbour
blurb: Ulyana Quintana, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, has spent ten years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
